behaviors.description: Under the committed strict policy the verdict command accepts the request it is given and exits 0.
behaviors.observableSuccessCriterion: The run says verdict: accepted on stdout and exits 0.

directions.text: The judge request command (with the supplied stdin prompt): its exit code and the standard output you obtained is asserted to satisfy every declared condition together. The declared polarity expects this relation to hold. The exit code and stdout of the judge run. A run that exited non-zero, or whose stdout does not say verdict: accepted is treated as a defect.

safetyLimits: The verdict command makes no network call.
